rv.q: Transferring from the Edinburgh Fringe, Barnes pens a biting, dark satire. The piece is an excellent business card: her observations are acute and well-calibrated, her performance is witty and thoroughly engaging.
Minor gripes aside Ms HSB has the chutzpah to deliver a yarn with confidence albeit the material would benefit from a slower and clear narrative arc.
A towering performance from an extremely talented writer and performer.
As it is, this is a great show: bold, funny and compelling.
It is funny, disarming, and occasionally disturbing, and is certainly helped by Honor's personable performance...

cn.t: Critics find Florence a mixed but intriguing solo show. Honor Santa Barnes earns praise for her energised performance, though the piece divides opinion on its overall impact.
